requirements.title: Aircraft Business Portfolios
requirements.definition: Create the requested customized aircraft-business portfolio deliverables, including the identified CAS Jets portfolio, with a premium, concise, high-impact presentation.
requirements.boundary_note: The requested count, CAS Jets identity, aircraft subject matter, and visual presentation are attributes of the portfolio deliverable set; evidence does not sufficiently identify the other portfolio as a separately trackable Requirement.

requirements.title: Business Brochures
requirements.definition: Create the requested set of business brochure artifacts.
requirements.boundary_note: Brochure quantity and possible packaging into one PDF are attributes of this deliverable rather than separate Requirements; portfolios and social-media content remain independently requested artifacts.

requirements.title: Business Pitch Content
requirements.definition: Create business-pitch content, including suitable written and visual material, as a distinct requested content deliverable.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers pitch-oriented copy and visual content; portfolio and brochure artifact design are separately requested deliverables.

requirements.title: Social Media Content
requirements.definition: Create the requested pieces of business content for social-media use.
requirements.boundary_note: Social-media content is independently requested from portfolios, brochures, and pitch content; the intended platform remains unresolved rather than defining separate platform Requirements.

unresolved_candidates.description: Possible later graphic modifications are mentioned only tentatively and do not yet establish an independent revision or graphics Requirement.
